summary: Pass. `cw_read` now tracks cumulative per-session character usage and truncates once the shared budget is exceeded.
evidence: src/mcp/tools/read.ts:14-70 defines the default 20k character budget and excerpt budgeting helper, and src/mcp/tools/read.ts:187-320 threads a stable session id through reads so usage accumulates per session.
tests/integration/read-budget.test.ts:62-105 verifies a second read in the same session emits `Warning: Budget exceeded` and truncates later lines, while a fresh session gets an untouched budget.
The passing full validator run confirms the budget tracking did not regress existing read-tool behaviors.
